asof.title: Stock as of a date
asof.timeHint: End of day by default: every move of that day counts.
asof.note: Values use the cost of that day's valuation rows. Held, reserved and available are not kept for past days, so they are not shown then.
asof.show: Show stock as of this date

held.invalid: That is not a day and time.
held.future: That moment has not come yet: pick today or an earlier day.

hold.intro: While the hold is on, nobody issues or cuts this stock: the floor and the office are refused with the reason.
hold.reachNone: nothing of it in stock now
hold.reserved_one: {count} work order already reserved it: {numbers}. It keeps its reservation but cannot issue the stock until the hold is released.
hold.reserved_other: {count} work orders already reserved it: {numbers}. They keep their reservations but cannot issue the stock until the hold is released.
hold.reservedNone: No work order has reserved it.
hold.reversal: To undo: a person of quality releases the hold (never the one who placed it).
hold.reasonsFailed: The reasons could not be read. Close and try again.
hold.reasonNoteHint: Shown with the hold wherever it stops someone.
hold.quarantine: Ask the floor to move it to a quarantine place
hold.quarantineNone: This site has no quarantine place.
hold.previewFailed: What the hold reaches could not be read. Close and try again.
hold.leftOut_one: {count} selected row has no lot and is left out.
hold.leftOut_other: {count} selected rows have no lot and are left out.
hold.done_one: On hold: {count} lot. Issuing and cutting it are refused with your reason.
hold.done_other: On hold: {count} lots. Issuing and cutting them are refused with your reason.

held.problem: One of them cannot be held: take it out of the selection first.
held.long: The note is longer than 500 characters.
held.noRight: Your role may not put stock on hold (quality.holds.place).
held.pastDate: Stock as of a past date cannot be changed.
held.pickLots: Select the rows of the lots to hold (rows with a lot).
held.noLot: This row has no lot: only lots and hides are held.

problem.rejected: rejected: it goes back to the supplier or is scrapped, never held
problem.consumed: used up: nothing of it is left to hold
problem.scrapped: scrapped: nothing of it is left to hold
problem.other: cannot be held in its state
problem.forbidden: Your role may not put stock on hold.
problem.subjects: One of them cannot be held now (its state changed). Close and read the stock again.
problem.reasonCode: That reason is not on the hold list any more. Pick another.
problem.reasonNote: The note was not accepted (at most 500 characters; this reason needs one).
problem.place: That quarantine place was not accepted. Pick another.

reserve.title_one: Reserve {count} hide to a work order
reserve.title_other: Reserve {count} hides to a work order
reserve.intro: Each hide is reserved whole: no other work order can count on it, and it is issued only to this one.
reserve.search: Find a work order by number, batch or style
reserve.workOrdersFailed: The work orders could not be read. Try again.
reserve.noRightWorkOrders: Your role does not see work orders (workorders.view): reservations are made from the work order.
reserve.noteHint: Optional: for the cutter or the planner.

held.none: None of the selected hides is free to reserve.
held.noRight: Your role may not reserve stock (inventory.reserve).

refusal.HIDE_NOT_IN_STOCK: A hide is not in stock at this site any more. Close and read the hides again.
refusal.HIDE_RESERVED: A hide was reserved meanwhile for another work order. Close and read the hides again.
refusal.LOT_HELD: A hide's lot is not released: held stock is not reserved.
refusal.NOT_AVAILABLE: Not enough of this leather is free at the site: other reservations hold it.
refusal.LOT_NOT_AVAILABLE: Not enough of this lot is free: other reservations hold it.

problem.forbidden: Your role may not reserve stock here.
problem.workOrder: That work order cannot take reservations (it is not open, or its materials do not include this leather).
problem.notOpen: That work order is not open any more. Pick another.

wo.title: Write off
wo.intro: The stock leaves the site for good, with its reason. The ledger keeps the move; a lot or untracked material can be put back by reversing the move in Movements.
wo.introHides: Each hide leaves the stock whole and becomes scrapped: that is final, a scrapped hide is never reversed.
wo.reasonsFailed: The reasons could not be read. Close and try again.
wo.noteHint: Kept with the move for good.
wo.referenceHint: A claim, an NCR or a count sheet (optional).
wo.photoReady: Photo ready ({width} × {height}): it is sent once the write-off is posted.
wo.photoHint: Optional: the damage, where it is.
wo.photoNoRight: Your role may not add files (files.upload).
wo.ncrHint: Quality follows the cause up; the NCR is raised from the lot or the hide.
wo.ncrNone: A nonconformance needs a lot or a hide: this material has neither.
wo.valueUnknown: Value leaving the stock: known once posted (no cost on record yet).

done.title: Written off
done.moves_one: {count} move posted: the stock left the site.
done.moves_other: {count} moves posted: the stock left the site.
done.photoFailed: The photo was not sent (the write-off is posted).
done.ncrFailed: The nonconformance was not opened (the write-off is posted).
done.overReserved_one: {count} material now has more reserved than there is: release or move a reservation.
done.overReserved_other: {count} materials now have more reserved than there is: release or move a reservation.

held.onHold: Hide {code} is on hold: quality decides it (its NCR scraps it). Take it out of the selection.
held.lotOnHold: Lot {code} is on hold: quality decides it (its NCR scraps it).
held.reserved: Hide {code} is reserved for {demand}: release that reservation first.
held.note: This reason needs a note: say what happened.
held.long: The note is longer than 500 characters.
held.noRight: Your role may not write off stock (inventory.scrap).
held.noKey: Open Movements from a stock figure (a material at a place) to write it off here.
held.pastDate: Stock as of a past date cannot be changed.
held.consumed: A hide that is used up or scrapped has nothing left to scrap.
held.severity: Say how serious the problem is: the NCR needs it.

problem.onHold: This stock went on hold meanwhile: quality decides it now. Nothing was written off.
problem.reserved: A hide is reserved for a work order: release that reservation first. Nothing was written off.
problem.reasonCode: That reason is not on the write-off list any more. Pick another.
problem.notInStock: This stock is not there any more. Close and read the figures again.
problem.forbidden: Your role may not write off stock here.
